scope: Prefer provided macOS MCP capabilities; real public search-link reading and bounded Apple text-planner selection
sourceBinding: Hashes identify the final compiled nine-test checkpoint. Earlier probe source revisions were not separately hashed; their changed scopes and all outcomes are retained below.

stages.implemented: Production planner instructions prefer suitable provided tools for the next step. Closed observed-ID selection is diagnostic only.
stages.tested: Nine current methods pass, zero skips; includes two real public link workflows and seven focused regressions.
stages.accepted: MCP link reading and constrained link-selection capability only. General browser admission, query generation, full natural-language movie task, provider/physical-phone handoff and whole-Mac resource acceptance remain open.

policy: macOS MCP first when it can perform the needed step. Investigate missing tool integration before requiring computer-use-model inference. Preserve task ownership and possible prior effects across continuation.
findings: Pinned MacControlMCP returns an exact AXLink title and actual AXURL for the venue result; native page evidence independently matches it. This disproves a blanket claim that MCP cannot read these browser results.

The actual search link is a provider redirect, not a direct venue URL. Opening the observed URL followed by bounded fresh observation reaches the official source. No URL is decoded or reconstructed from a provider parameter.
A completed first redirect document is not proof of reaching the destination. The no-effect observation loop sees the eventual page without issuing a second navigation.

Production planner instructions previously demanded visual fallback for all website reads even when a usable tool was supplied. They now ask for tools that advance the next step while retaining the full goal and its constraints. No new generic AX tools are advertised in normal executor composition by this change.
The first Apple selection chooses Fandango; the next chooses an image-search result and invents attribute names. Both failures are retained and neither navigates to that chosen result.

The final diagnostic constrains the proposal to an observed element ID. Host code supplies AXRole, AXTitle and AXURL through the original helper tool schema, verifies the returned data and rechecks native correspondence before following the actual link.

The final catalogue also includes bounded native captions for the same actual URL. Nine tests pass; one successful real selection does not establish general semantic accuracy or isolate each change causally.

The general browser research driver is not composed by the production native loader. Broad find_elements/get_element_attributes are not in the normal structured-planner surface. Tool capability exists, but a complete MCP browser route is still an integration gap.
nextEvidence: Integrate the observed-ID read contract at a task-owned browser boundary; first test stale helper/document/ownership, unknown IDs, ambiguous matches, partial/truncated results, cancellation and no effect replay. Preserve native navigation and login authority.

Qualify query generation and iterative reading/selection against full natural-language goals through the normal HostSession route. The current query and discovery filters are test-scripted; this is not an end-to-end goal success.
Test varied official/public sources and held-out tasks before accepting semantic source selection. Do not hardcode venue names, captions, expected dates, URLs or coordinates in production.
Keep Fara as a fallback for demonstrated unsupported steps; investigate its previously retained request/transport/decode failure only when that fallback is actually needed.

faraCompatibilityResearch.coordinateConvention: Author uses normalized 0–1000 coordinates. [236,731] on a 960×568 viewport maps to [226.56,415.208]; current conversion is correct.
faraCompatibilityResearch.observationDifference: Upstream normally supplies screenshot and URL, with whole-document extraction requested on demand. Automatic raw observed_page text is an app extension. Offscreen text confusing target choice is plausible, not proven.
